summary: Hawaiian Electric Company (a subsidiary of Hawaiian Electric Industries) filed an 8-K reporting a new Power Purchase Agreement with Kalaeloa Partners L.P. This is a routine utility supply contract, not a special situation. The New PPA replaces an existing agreement, providing 208 MW of firm renewable dispatchable capacity for 30 years, with a reduced fixed capacity charge of $93/kW per year and updated operations and maintenance pricing. It is a standard contract entered into in the ordinary course of business for electric services. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or corporate event is involved. There is no risk-arb angle; the filing merely discloses contractual terms.
